 Aries Shani Horoscope Today, 7 November 2026: Hanuman Jayanti and Shani Retrograde Bring Strength to Hard Choices 
 Trending Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Horoscope Today Aries Horoscope Today Daily Carrer Horoscope Nadi Horoscope Taurus Horoscope Today Gemini Horoscope Today Aries Shani Horoscope Today, 7 November 2026: Hanuman Jayanti and Shani Retrograde Bring Strength to Hard Choices 
 Neeraj Dhankher / TOI Astrology / Nov 07, 2026, 01:15 IST Save Comments Share Aa + Text Size Small
 Medium
 Large
 Print Courage feels within reach for Aries this Saturday. Many parts of North India observe Hanuman Jayanti today on Kartik Krishna Chaturdashi, the same day as Narak Chaturdashi, or Chhoti Diwali. It also falls on Shanivar, Shani’s own weekday. Tradition holds that Hanuman’s devotees receive protection from Shani’s harsher effects. Shani, retrograde in Pisces, your twelfth, keeps Sade Sati’s first phase running. A difficult decision you have avoided may now feel possible to face. Hanuman Jayanti on Shanivar
 Hanuman stands for strength used in service, not in pride. For Aries, ruled by Mars, this connection runs deep, since Hanuman is closely linked with Mars energy in devotional tradition. Prayer today can steady a nervous mind. Your choice may involve ending something, such as a draining job task, an unhealthy habit, or a one-sided arrangement. Hanuman’s example suggests acting with humility and firmness together. Shani in the Twelfth Clears the Way
 Shani in your twelfth governs endings, release and quiet sacrifice. In retrograde, it may show you clearly what must be let go. That clarity may hurt, but it saves you from a longer struggle later. The Moon passes through Virgo, your sixth house of obstacles and rivals, and moves toward Chitra. An opposition from a colleague or a health concern may trigger your decision. Shani’s seventh aspect falls on the Moon’s sign, adding seriousness. Take the step slowly, but take it. Narak Chaturdashi Cleansing
 Many families take an early oil bath today to remove negativity before Diwali. That practice suits Aries well. Clearing clutter from your room or desk also helps you make decisions. Mars Still in Cancer
 Mars, your ruling planet, stays debilitated in Cancer, your fourth. Doubts may come from home or from feeling unsupported. Hanuman’s day reminds you that strength can grow from faith, even when your energy feels low. Do’s for Today
 Pray to Hanuman before making a big decision.
 Clear clutter from your room or desk.
 Write the pros and cons of the choice in front of you.
 Don’ts for Today
 Do not decide out of anger.
 Avoid postponing the choice for no reason.
 Skip boasting about what you plan to do.
 Shani Remedy for Today
 Offer sindoor mixed with jasmine oil to Lord Hanuman and read the Bajrang Baan once at dusk. Give boondi prasad and a glass of water to devotees waiting in a Shani temple queue.
